description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes (tree width) and accuracy@1 for two models, GPT-4o and another unnamed model. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The first line, representing GPT-4o, is blue with circular markers and is solid. It begins at (1, 24.4), increases to (3, 27.8), continues to (5, 34.4), and then decreases to (7, 31.1). The second line, represented by x markers and a light blue color, begins at (1, 26.7), increases to (3, 28.9), decreases to (5, 24.4), and ends at (7, 20.0).
